source: Sifra, Metzora Parashat Zavim, Section 4 1-8 + Onkelos Lev 15:19
claim_en: THE SOURCE AND THE TABLE. Day-old niddah, ten-day zavah; the five bloods at their second seat; inside-as-outside; all seven, no early immersion.
THE MAJORITY GRID. Designated both directions; the fraction table zav-vs-bed; the touch/carry splitter named.
THE DEMOTION OPERATOR. Severe-to-light detachment stated by the verse; his bed as his touch; the loaf case; count from the last lying.

source: Sifra, Metzora Parashat Zavim, Section 5 1-9 + Chapter 8 1-3
claim_en: THE ELEVEN-DAY WINDOW. Two-and-three by the minimal-seizure rule; open-not-lock; the window built inclusion by inclusion; the 25/100 computations.

source: Sifra, Metzora Parashat Zavim, Chapter 8 5-10 + Chapter 9 1-5
claim_en: THE WATCHER. Day against day only; she defiles her partner, he not his — in clean language; impurity not days; her designation binds.

source: Sifra, Metzora Parashat Zavim, Chapter 9 2-12 + Onkelos Lev 15:31
claim_en: THE PRESENCE CLAUSE. Separation performed by Onkelos; even impure, the Presence among them; the three tiers; the fence; the adornment revision.
